notes.title: Join the Beta Testing of Happy Dogfights!
notes.content:
Hello Community!

We are running a new phase of our beta testing program and will be distributing 100 beta keys of Happy Dogfights on a first come, first served basis.

 [url=https://happydogfights.nodragemgames.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681567/9078497c1bf846cf77c977aa25fa9dabb001aaa2.gif[/img][/url]

Please apply on [url=https://happydogfights.nodragemgames.com]Happy Dogfight!'s website[/url]. 
We will send you an email to tell you whether you've got one of the keys!
Once you're set up, you will be able to join the Discord to meet other beta testers and try the game in multiplayer. We can't wait to set up some matches with you!

If you're too late and [b][u]missed your chance to get a key, don't worry![/u][/b]

You can still find a beta tester willing to play the game with you through Steam Remote Play or Parsec! Just [url=https://discord.gg/TCEKa4D]join our Discord[/url], and ask around if someone is free for a quick game!

[url=https://discord.gg/TCEKa4D][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681567/dc1ce3041c5841d3261e8a2c8e6793d79a92e236.png[/img][/url]

We hope to see you around soon!

Nodragem | Sole Game Developer
